query: UPDATE central.recovery_epoch_workspaces AS work SET delivery_state = 'claimed', claim_token_hash = $3, claim_expires_at = clock_timestamp() + interval '30 seconds', updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE work.epoch_generation = $1 AND work.workspace_id = $2 AND work.delivery_state = 'pending' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM central.recovery_epochs AS epoch WHERE epoch.epoch_generation = work.epoch_generation AND epoch.coordinator_domain = $4)
